directAnswer: Yes, Thunderbolt is compatible with USB-C, as Thunderbolt 3 and 4 use the USB-C connector. However, not all USB-C ports support Thunderbolt functionality.
summary: Thunderbolt and USB-C share the same physical connector, but compatibility depends on the specific implementation of the USB-C port.

sections.heading: Thunderbolt Versions and USB-C Compatibility
sections.body: Thunderbolt 3 and Thunderbolt 4 utilize the USB-C connector, allowing for data transfer, video output, and power delivery. However, earlier versions of Thunderbolt (1 and 2) use a different connector and are not compatible with USB-C.

sections.heading: How to Check Compatibility
sections.body: To determine if a USB-C port supports Thunderbolt, look for a lightning bolt icon next to the port or check the device specifications from the manufacturer.

steps.title: Identify the USB-C port
steps.detail: Look for a lightning bolt icon next to the USB-C port on your device.

steps.title: Check device specifications
steps.detail: Visit the manufacturer's website and search for your device model to confirm if the USB-C port supports Thunderbolt.

steps.title: Test with a Thunderbolt device
steps.detail: Connect a Thunderbolt device to the USB-C port to see if it is recognized. If it works, the port supports Thunderbolt.

faqs.question: Can I use a Thunderbolt cable with a USB-C device?
faqs.answer: Yes, Thunderbolt cables are compatible with USB-C devices, but the device will only operate at USB-C speeds and capabilities.

faqs.question: What happens if I connect a Thunderbolt device to a non-Thunderbolt USB-C port?
faqs.answer: The Thunderbolt device will not function, as the non-Thunderbolt port does not support the necessary protocols.

faqs.question: Are all USB-C ports the same?
faqs.answer: No, USB-C ports can have different capabilities, including data transfer speeds and power delivery, depending on the device and its specifications.

caveats: While Thunderbolt 3 and 4 are compatible with USB-C, not all USB-C ports support Thunderbolt features, so always verify compatibility.
